description: This file defines an actor 'MacNodeBrowserProxy' that facilitates network requests to a local server, manages proxy payloads, and handles file data including base64 encoding, primarily for a macOS application. It includes methods for constructing requests, parsing responses, and managing proxy files, and interacts with external protocols such as 'OpenClawProtocol'.

classes.name: MacNodeBrowserProxy
classes.description: An actor class providing networking capabilities to interact with a local server and manage file proxies for a macOS application.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous network request based on JSON parameters, processes the response, and returns a JSON string containing results and proxy file info.

methods.name: defaultEndpoint
methods.description: Provides a default endpoint configuration with localhost URL and credentials.

methods.name: decodeRequestParams
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a RequestParams object.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Constructs a URLRequest from given request parameters and an endpoint.

methods.name: requireHTTPResponse
methods.description: Ensures a URLResponse is an HTTPURLResponse, throws if not.

methods.name: httpErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message string based on HTTP status code and response data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts an Any value into a string representation for query parameters.

methods.name: loadProxyFiles
methods.description: Loads proxy files from a response payload, returning an array of ProxyFilePayload.

methods.name: collectProxyPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects file paths from a nested response payload.

methods.name: loadProxyFile
methods.description: Reads file data at a given path, encodes it in base64, determines MIME type, and returns a ProxyFilePayload.
